sentences.text: Hello, and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Qatar.
Qatar is a small, rich, and modern country
in the Middle East.
Let's learn about it, Meezy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Qatar?
Qatar is in Western Asia in the Middle East.
It is on a small peninsula in the Persian Gulf.
It shares a land border with Saudi Arabia
and is close to Bahrain, United Arab Emirates,
and Iran across the sea.
It has dessert, coastline, and modern cities.
What is the capital city of Qatar?
The capital city is Doha.
Doha is a large, modern, and clean city.
It has tall buildings, museums, malls,
and the Cornish, a road by the sea.
Other towns include Al-Wakra, Al-Hore,
Lusail, a new smart city.
How many people live in Qatar?
About 3 million people live in Qatar.
But most are foreign workers from other countries.
Only around 300,000 are Qatari citizens.
Qatar has people from India, Nepal,
Philippines, Egypt, Bangladesh, and many other countries.
What language do people speak in Qatar?
The official language is Arabic.
But many people speak English,
especially in business and tourism.
Other languages spoken include Hindi, Tagalog,
Urdu, and Nepali.
What is the weather like in Qatar?
Qatar has a hot desert climate.
It is very hot and dry most of the year.
Summer made in September is extremely hot
over 40 degrees Celsius.
Winter, December to February is mild and pleasant.
There is little rain in the sky is usually clear.
What does Qatar look like?
Qatar has flat desert land, sand dunes,
beaches in the Persian Gulf,
modern buildings in tall towers, palm trees,
parks, and clean streets.
It is a mix of traditional desert and modern city life.
What animals live in Qatar?
In Qatar, you may see camels and goats in the desert,
Falcons, a national symbol,
oryx, a white desert antelope,
lizards, foxes, and desert birds.
In the sea, fish, crabs, and dolphins.
Falcons are used in traditional hunting
and are highly respected.
What people eat in Qatar?
Qatari food is rich,
spiced, and often includes rice and meat.
People eat lamb, chicken, and fish.
Rice, dates, and yogurt.
Vegetables, bread, and spices.
Popular dishes.
Match booze.
Spiced rice with meat or fish.
Haris, wheat with meat,
slow-cooked.
The reed, bread with vegetables and broth.
Sambusa, fried pastry with filling.
Dates and Arabic coffee are served to guests
as a warm welcome.
What do people drink in Qatar?
People drink.
Water, very important in the hot weather.
Carrot tea, black tea with milk and spices.
Arabic coffee with cardamom,
served in small cups.
Fruit juice, lemon mint, and soft drinks.
Alcohol is not common and is mostly for tourists
in special places.
What is life in Qatar?
Life in Qatar is a mix of tradition and modern living.
People enjoy spending time with family,
going to malls and cafes,
visiting the beach or desert,
watching sports, especially football,
shopping, driving, and dining out.
Qataris often wear traditional clothes.
Men wear Toby, white robe, women wear a biop,
black dress, and head scarf.
What are some holidays and traditions in Qatar?
National Day, December 18th,
with parades and fireworks.
Eat our feeder after Ramadan,
with gifts and meals.
Eat al-Ada, festival of sacrifice.
Ramadan, a holy month of fasting.
Qatar National Sports Day,
2nd Tuesday of February.
Family, faith, and hospitality
are very important in Qatari culture.
Some fun facts about Qatar.
Qatar will host the 2027 Fiba Basketball World Cup.
It hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2022,
the first in the Middle East.
Qatar is one of the richest countries in the world.
The national animal is the Arabian oryx.
The flag is white and maroon with a zigzag edge.
Now you know many things about Qatar.
You know where it is,
what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about the land, traditions, and modern life.
Great job.
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Arabic,
Maas Salama.
